title: Dose Witness
user: Families coordinating an elderly relative’s medications who need every caregiver to see whether a particular dose was actually given.
smallest_useful_product: A local-first PWA for one household: medication cards, scheduled doses, an explicit given/skipped/uncertain status, caregiver initials, offline printable handoff, and encrypted export/import between devices.
constraints: Accessible type, contrast, and large controls
